title: Image Generation
summary: Generate AI images from text prompts using models like BytePlus Seedream 3.0. Supports 1:1, 16:9, 9:16 and other aspect ratios. Priced per request.

title: Video Generation
summary: Generate AI videos from text or images using BytePlus MegaCreator and Wan models. Supports 5-10s clips in various aspect ratios. Priced per second.

title: Voice & TTS
summary: Generate natural speech from text using BytePlus Seed-TTS 2.0. Choose from multiple voices and languages. Priced per 1,000 characters.

title: Digital Spokesperson Studio
summary: Create talking avatar videos with OmniHuman 1.5 — upload a portrait image and provide a script or audio. Priced per second of video.

title: Generation Templates
summary: Use pre-built templates for common workflows — fill in variables and generate in one click.

title: Asset Library
summary: All your generated and uploaded files live here. Organise with folders, tags and favourites. Originals are kept private; grid views use optimised thumbnails.

title: Credits & Billing
summary: Credits are the currency for generation. Top up via manual payment. 1 credit = 1 baisa. Credits are reserved before generation starts and charged on completion.

title: Projects
summary: Organise your generation work into projects. Each generation job can belong to a project for easy filtering.

title: AI Chat (Creative Characters)
summary: Chat with AI personas — roleplay characters, creative directors, and more. Supports voice output via Seed-TTS.
